subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2701
title: Requires health care facilities, health care providers, local public health authorities and public and private safety agencies to maintain capacity, including sufficient amounts of certain supplies, to continue in normal operation for 120 days at a 25 percent mortality rate.
headline: HB 2701 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2701 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2701 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
